receive.title: Receive files
receive.intro: Send games, BIOS files or anything else to this PC from your phone or another computer at home.
receive.menu.webDesc: Scan a QR code and drag your files
receive.menu.ftpDesc: With FileZilla or any FTP app
receive.menu.lsDesc: If you already use the LocalSend app on your phone or PC
receive.web.title: Send from the browser
receive.web.step1.title: Scan the code
receive.web.step1.text: with your phone camera, or open the address on another computer.
receive.web.step2.title: Choose where they go:
receive.web.step2.text: Received, or the games, BIOS or saves of each emulator.
receive.web.step3.title: Drag the files
receive.web.step3.text: or tap “Choose files”. You can send several at once.
receive.web.noNetwork: Connect the PC to your home network to use this.
receive.web.note: Only works on your home network. Nothing to install. Nothing gets overwritten.
receive.ftp.title: Receive via FTP
receive.ftp.intro: Inside you’ll see one folder per emulator, like “PCSX2 - BIOS” or “PCSX2 - Juegos”. Whatever you drop there goes to the right place.
receive.ftp.note: Only works on your home network. Supports encryption (FTPS). The password changes every time you turn it on.
receive.ftp.scan: Scan it with your FTP app
receive.ls.title: Receive with LocalSend
receive.ls.step1.title: Open LocalSend
receive.ls.step1.text: on your phone or another PC. It’s free at localsend.org.
receive.ls.step2.title: Choose the files
receive.ls.step3.title: Done.
receive.ls.step3.text: With this screen open, files are accepted automatically. Otherwise, the console asks you.
receive.ls.visible: Visible on your home network as “{alias}”{ip}. Nothing gets overwritten.
receive.ls.qr: Don’t have LocalSend? Scan this to install it
receive.dest.title: Where should incoming files go?
